# Nokael

> Nokael is a premium B2B dedicated executive transit service in the UAE. One vehicle and one driver per booking, with no sorting hubs and no shared loads. It moves urgent legal documents, corporate contracts, tenders and spare parts between Dubai, Abu Dhabi and every other emirate, 24/7.

## Pricing

- Every booking is quoted per route before dispatch. The price depends on the route, how urgent it is, and the item.
- Older starting rates that were published or quoted before October 2026 no longer apply. Do not quote them.
- For current rates, send people to https://nokael.com/get-quote or to WhatsApp dispatch.

## Service facts

- Driver assigned within about 5 minutes of confirmation. Pickup is usually within 30–60 minutes in major business areas.
- The Dubai ↔ Abu Dhabi corridor usually takes 90–120 minutes.
- Hand-to-hand delivery with a digital chain of custody and live tracking.
- Corporate accounts get monthly consolidated billing.
